name: Parnesse
description: Errant's wife, an artist who is wounded in the leg and who joins the resistance with her.

description_citations.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights

timeline.summary: Toluz agrees to tell Anhelo about the woman in white only if he kills Fiero Vespin, who has attacked her daughter Parnesse, by tomorrow's wedding.
timeline.quote: "If you want information for your Family, you have to do a little work for ours. Bump him off, and we'll talk,"

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: In a dream-memory of her wedding, Errant and Parnesse dance among the Maestros until Phyrexian oil transforms the guests, including her father Anhelo, and Atraxa tears off the roof.
timeline.quote: the roof of the Maestro's museum was ripped clean off

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Errant wakes in an abandoned station when a converter beast crashes through the wall, hunting her and Parnesse.
timeline.quote: The crash of a Phyrexian converter beast plunging through the wall had shattered their brief reprieve.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Errant and Parnesse flee over rails and ledges with stolen Riveteer explosives, using tagger's scrawl to find safe paths.
timeline.quote: The two heavy satchels that were laden with the explosives they had stolen from an old Riveteer's stash in the Mezzio clanked against her hips

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Cornered by two converter beasts, Errant and Parnesse choose to blow themselves up rather than be converted.
timeline.quote: "I love you until every canvas is filled."

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Errant wakes in the resistance hideout and learns Della healed them with Halo.
timeline.quote: Luckily, I was present to mend your wounds instantly

timeline.summary: Errant agrees to place the charges after Parnesse insists on the choice, and the team explains Operation Falling Star.

timeline.summary: The families rally; Falco's Brokers take position, Della rallies angels, and Parnesse shepherds citizens while Errant heads for the core.
timeline.quote: But, at last, they had worked out the final details.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Errant reunites with Parnesse and her allies at the safe zone as the angels depart.
timeline.quote: "Parnesse!" Errant opened her arms just in time for Parnesse to throw herself into them.
